description: tools/distill-telemetry.exs:221 calls Map.update(acc, reason, n, &(&1 + n)); fz has Map.update!/3 but not update/4, so the distiller fails with error[resolve/unknown-import]: module Map does not export update/4. Elixir: update(map, key, default, fun) puts default when key is absent, else fun.(existing). Build it in Elixir's shape in lib/map.fz with docs and an oracle fixture on interp, run and build.
title: Map.update/4 exists
